newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil gov't sees CVRD sale going ahead.
newsitem.headline: Brazil gov't sees CVRD sale going ahead.

text.p: Jose Roberto Mendonca de Barros, economic policy secretary at the Brazilian Finance Ministry, on Monday said he believed the April 29 auction of Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD) would go ahead.

"I am convinced the auction will happen tomorrow," Mendonca de Barros told reporters, adding he was sure the government's lawyers had the "ability" to contest a series of injunctions that have been issued against the sale.
Mendonca de Barros was speaking before a Sao Paulo judge rejected a government appeal against one of those injunctions.

Sources at the National Development Bank (BNDES) said Jose Pio Borges, the BNDES's privatization director, was holding a meeting with his team. They added that the prospects for the CVRD sale had turned a little more murky after the rejection of the appeal in Sao Paulo.
Some 45 percent of CVRD's voting shares is due to be auctioned at 1000 local time (1300 GMT) Tuesday at the Rio de Janeiro bolsa.
